item.title: Kurobe Gorge Railway: An Open-Air Trolley Train Through a Dramatic Ravine — Guide
item.description: The Kurobe Gorge Railway is a narrow-gauge trolley train that winds slowly along a steep, densely forested ravine once used to transport workers and materials during construction of the Kurobe hydroelectric dams. Its open-air carriages, running between Unazuki Onsen and Keyakidaira, cross numerous bridges and tunnels above the rushing Kurobe River, and the gorge is considered one of Japan’s finest autumn foliage viewing spots, drawing large crowds each October and November.
